# Youtube Transcript Scraper

The Apify actor [`pintostudio/youtube-transcript-scraper`](https://apify.com/pintostudio/youtube-transcript-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **1.0.63**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Looking for a reliable way to extract transcripts from YouTube videos? 🎥✨ Look no further! The YouTube-Transcript-Scraper has you covered. 🚀 It effortlessly retrieves transcripts while offering additional valuable insights. Ready to start? Let’s scrape away! 🕵️‍♂️💻

## Pricing

Pay per event — result $0.01 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/pintostudio/youtube-transcript-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/pintostudio-youtube-transcript-scraper@1.0.63#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      videoUrl: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `videoUrl` | string | yes |  | URL of the Youtube video — The Video URL from YouTube. |
| `targetLanguage` | string | yes | `"en"` | Target Language — ISO 639-1 language code for the transcript |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array \| null | Ordered list of caption segments for the requested video, each with a start time, duration, and the spoken text. |
